### 2026-10-20 – This is an entry for yesterday and practically just a clone of my idea reel.

**2.4h**

This is an entry for yesterday and practically just a clone of my idea reel.

I forgot to make a reel, again, so i couldn't put this in yesterday. First of all I created a bill of materials so I didnt create something that I cant finance. After that I sketched out a little drawing on what I wanted my version to look like. After that I realized that the micro-controller would not have enough pins. So I worked on finding out what would work, and it was the same as halflifes.

Contuining to forget the reel I created a schematic with 15 leds, which I hope isnt overkill. Nothing much to say about it lol, had to download the half life files first ig.

Thanks for reading.

### 2026-10-23 – Time to catch up...

**2.9h**

Time to catch up...

No school on friday luckily, I haven't had much time to work on the project this week due to school. So today I worked for a while in order to try and catch up. I remade my footprint of the little touch sensitive pads. It took me a while to figure out making shapes and such. But enventually I got it done. When I was finished with that I moved onto designing the board.

For the board I made a layout that I though worked nicely. I really liked my star design from week 1 so I did the same thing with this board. I used LEDS to make the stars glow, they are made to shine through the stars. All i did was place the compenents and draw the design. Tommorrow ill get to work on routing this board which looks to be a nightmare.

Thanks for reading.
